summary: SPAC Axiom Intelligence Acquisition Corp 1 filed an 8-K on May 25, 2026, announcing entry into a Business Combination Agreement with Swiss quantum computing company Terra Quantum AG. The de-SPAC transaction involves formation of a Swiss PubCo and a Cayman merger sub, with Terra Quantum shareholders contributing shares to a Swiss HoldCo pre-closing. Transaction terms (price per share, implied value, premium) are not disclosed in the excerpt. The special committee and boards of both SPAC and Terra Quantum approved the deal. No break fee or timeline is provided. Watch for shareholder vote, redemptions, and regulatory clearances in a risk-arb context.
